name: Vladimir
title: the Crimson Reaper

Q.name: Transfusion
Q.description: Vladimir drains his target's lifeforce, dealing 80/100/120/140/160 + 0.6×AP magic damage and restoring 20/25/30/35/40 + 0.35×AP Health. After using this Ability twice, Vladimir gains 10+ (by level)% Move Speed for 0.5 seconds and empowers the next use of this Ability for 2.5 seconds. The empowered version of this Ability deals (80/100/120/140/160 + 0.6×AP) × 1.85 magic damage instead and restores an additional (097cda4f) × 1 plus ((5 + 0.04×AP) × 0.01) × 1 missing Health.
Q.summary: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.

W.name: Sanguine Pool
W.description: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood for 2 seconds, gaining 37.5% decaying Move Speed for 1 second and becoming Untargetable and Ghosted while Slowing enemies in the pool by 40%. Vladimir deals 80/135/190/245/300 + 0.15×bonus max HP magic damage and restores (80/135/190/245/300 + 0.15×bonus max HP) × 0.3 Health per enemy over the duration.
W.summary: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.

E.name: Tides of Blood
E.description: Begin Charging: Vladimir charges up a reservoir of blood, spending up to 0.08×max HP Health. While at full charge, Vladimir is Slowed by 20%. Release: Vladimir unleashes a torrent of blood missiles at surrounding enemies, dealing between 30/45/60/75/90 + 0.015×max HP + 0.35×AP and 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.06×max HP + 0.8×AP magic damage based on charge time. If this Ability was charged for at least 1 second, it also Slows targets by 40/45/50/55/60% for 0.5 seconds.
E.summary: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.

R.name: Hemoplague
R.description: Vladimir creates a virulent plague, causing its victims to take 10% increased damage from all sources for 4 seconds. After it expires, Vladimir deals 150/250/350 + 0.7×AP magic damage to all infected targets. Vladimir restores 150/250/350 + 0.7×AP Health if he hits a champion, and restores an additional (150/250/350 + 0.7×AP) × 0.4 Health for each champion beyond the first.
R.summary: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.

Passive.name: Crimson Pact
Passive.description: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).
Passive.summary: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Health-cost mage who sustains through lane with point-and-click Q and turns fights with Hemoplague and W pool. Weak and short-ranged early, he scales into a hard-to-kill teamfight threat.
strengths: Point-and-click Q poke and heal, empowered every few casts (Crimson Rush)
W pool makes him untargetable: dodges almost any key ability or burst
No mana: spells cost health, so long lanes don't run dry
Strong late-game teamfights with R amplifying damage and healing
Sustain lets him survive poke lanes
weaknesses: Very weak levels 1–3 and before first item; short range for a mage
Long cooldowns early: if W is down he has no escape
Grievous Wounds cuts his whole kit
Low wave clear early (E needs ranks), easy to freeze on
Gets bullied by early all-in lanes

curve.lvl2: weak – Q+E poke but no escape
curve.lvl3: medium – W lets him escape or dodge an all-in
curve.items: strong – first item (Riftmaker or Hextech Rocketbelt) and stacked Q/E ranks

profile.curveNote: Trades with Q only early; waits for W before taking real fights and for level 6 / first item to all-in.
profile.waveClear: medium – E clears once it has ranks; poor before
profile.sustain: high – Q heal, empowered Q, R

Q.notes: Point-and-click; empowered every few casts (bigger damage and heal). Can't be dodged except by untargetable/spell shield.

W.notes: 2 s untargetable pool that slows: dodges key crowd control and burst.

E.notes: Charge-up area around him; slows when fully charged.

R.notes: Area that amplifies damage taken, then damages and heals per champion hit.

Passive.notes: Bonus health converts to AP and vice versa.

profile.windowAgainst: W on cooldown: he can't escape or dodge, all-in. Also levels 1–3 and before first item.
checks: Exact E mechanic (whether it can be cancelled by damage) and E slow condition
